checks.name: First visit uses light mode even when the operating system prefers dark
Explicit dark and system preferences persist and respond to system changes
Warm surfaces retain readable text/action contrast, curved panels and keyboard focus
Search and sorting survive details, navigation and reload within the private browser session
Typing is debounced so partial search terms do not issue redundant requests
Changed-query loading hides old rows and late responses cannot replace current matches
A failed query stops loading, explains the error and recovers through Try again
Reset clears filters and pagination loads the correct result slice
Light and dark explorers fit 390/768/1024px and maintain readable contrast
Reduced-motion preference suppresses animated control transitions
The search keyboard shortcut focuses the field without entering a stray slash
Twenty real UI event signals coalesce into at most two dashboard refreshes
Simulated hidden-tab lifecycle pauses actual polling and refreshes on return
A different account cannot inherit the previous user's filters or opportunity rows
